description:
“Deokswe, ah… you have to follow along with the next part too.” He’s just a servant. A lowly one beneath me. But… I don’t want to stop like this. “This is only so I can learn the proper refinement of a noble young lady… You know that too, don’t you, Deokswe?” “I do, haa… You have to finish this whole book today, my lady…” Jinhee, the young lady of a high official’s household with a wedding just ahead of her, had disliked Deokswe ever since he was little. She hated how pretty his face was, prettier than a girl’s. Every time he looked up at her with those big eyes, it irritated her. His body had grown broad and tall, yet his face was still so gentle. Though he was a man, his eyes looked as though they had stars embroidered in them, and though he was just a servant boy, his skin was smooth and flawless. Anyway, she should have disliked him… But then the face of the man in the erotic picture book she received as a gift, called “The Basic Refinement of a Noble Lady,” started to look like Deokswe. …Would it be like the erotic drawings inside? “My lady, I told you before. I’ll teach you with my body.”
